subject: College Grove Tree Planting
overview: The commission reviewed progress on the College Grove tree planting project and authorized permits for several athletic leagues. A fee adjustment was granted to a frisbee group due to lighting issues at Tufts Park.

items.title: College Grove Tree Planting and Celebration
items.summary: Representatives provided an update on soil preparation and fencing for the College Grove project and received a provisional permit for a community event on November 14th.

items.title: Hub Sports and FM Collective Permits
items.summary: The commission approved a permit for Hub Sports at Memorial Park and a performance grant for FM Collective at Riverside Plaza.

items.title: Wright's Pond Access Policy
items.summary: A proposal regarding vehicle stickers and walking passes for Wright's Pond was tabled until January.

items.title: Volo Permit for Tufts Park
items.summary: Approved a request for Volo to utilize field two at Tufts Park on Tuesday nights through mid-November.

items.title: Lampshade Fee Adjustment
items.summary: Reduced the permit fee for Lampshade Ultimate Frisbee by $300 because the lighting on Field 4 was inadequate for night play.

items.title: Minutes and Columbus Park Memorial
items.summary: Approved the August meeting minutes and tabled a proposed memorial at Columbus Park until February because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: January Planning and Policy Review
items.summary: The commission discussed future reviews of fee structures, pavilion reservation policies, and field priorities for youth sports.
